anchor.ownership_basis: 生产 DevOps Map 只读查询确认 GP 与 step 均属于 journey 工厂 · F2 部署闭环；复用既有行，不创建占位行。

journey_type_reason: P0 Golden Path 跨 built Brain image、真实 Fleet Worker/Runner、macOS OrbStack、Postgres、GitHub exact-head、Kernel 子进程及生产发布接缝；按 R7/R8 审计将 12 个 gate 串成线性依赖。

tasks.title: Gate 1：Brain image 自包含
tasks.scope: 构建 immutable Brain image，并在无 worktree mount 时导入 orchestrator、加载三个 profile。
dod: [BEHAVIOR] built image 加载 3/3 profile，missing-config 反事实非零
[ARTIFACT] Dockerfile 与 built-image smoke

tasks.title: Gate 2：原子 release 与 per-attempt snapshot
tasks.scope: 锁定 Runner digest、profile、Worker generation、runtime UID/GID、协议能力和 transport schema，并冻结每个 Attempt 的 immutable snapshot。
dod: [BEHAVIOR] concurrent profile upgrade 不改变已创建 Attempt snapshot
[BEHAVIOR] migration 367+ 真 PG upgrade/rollback parity

tasks.title: Gate 3：macOS installer 可回滚事务
tasks.scope: 在真实 macOS/OrbStack 身份边界交付 Docker-visible root、最小 ACL、身份、TMPDIR、plist/scripts/toolchain/credential-envelope 的 journaled transaction。
dod: [BEHAVIOR] 每个 mutation 独立失败且 rollback 仅撤销本次变更

tasks.title: Gate 4：真实 Worker admission
tasks.scope: 使 authenticated health 使用真实 Attempt 的 root/mount/ACL/UID/GID/secret/cleanup 合同，并在 Worker→exact Runner seam 的 Agent 前验证 stdout 可写和 GitHub auth。
dod: [BEHAVIOR] base_admitted 与 dispatch_ready 匹配 exact generation/digest
[BEHAVIOR] stdout 不可写时 Agent 未启动，持久化 1..2048 bytes 脱敏诊断

tasks.title: Gate 5：生产 preflight 与语义锚点
tasks.scope: fail closed 校验 remote/callback、URL 可达、immutable profile；把当前 task 从零行 placeholder 原子迁移并回读既有 DevOps Map journey/golden-path/step existence 和 ownership。
dod: [BEHAVIOR] task 4a530430... 回读的 anchor 精确等于合同既有三元组
[BEHAVIOR] 虚构 UUID、ownership 错误、task_id 等于 run_id、不可达 URL 均失败

tasks.title: Gate 6：phase-aware transport
tasks.scope: 实现 accepted/startup lease、分阶段预算、idempotency、cancel 和 truthful timeout evidence。
dod: [BEHAVIOR] slow mirror/image/secret 各有独立 code，active Attempt/provider/container 至多一个

tasks.title: Gate 7：secret、Git auth、artifact handoff 与反向 cleanup
tasks.scope: 完成 Docker-mediated single-use secret、attempt-scoped brokered GitHub auth、stdout、authenticated callback/commit transfer；exact Runner 创建 nested ignored/node_modules/untracked output 后，仅协调当前 attempt workspace/admin/runtime 的权限，再由 Worker 删除全部路径且 quarantine/state/secret residual zero。
dod: [BEHAVIOR] brokered GitHub auth 在 Agent 前验证且 success/timeout/crash/cancel 四终态 revoke+delete
[BEHAVIOR] callback artifact SHA/branch/task ownership 真验后才 cleanup
[BEHAVIOR] reverse cleanup 无 quarantine、无残留、无 shared-root 广泛权限变更

tasks.title: Gate 8：Kernel truthful readiness
tasks.scope: 在 spawn 前拒绝坏 worktree，并以真实 child ownership frame 与真 PG initial heartbeat 判 ready，提供有界脱敏诊断。
dod: [BEHAVIOR] real child+PG 正控通过，early exit/no-ready/spawn-error/timeout 失败

tasks.title: Gate 9：Watchdog truthful recovery
tasks.scope: 初启与 watchdog 复用 readiness；补 ESRCH-only local liveness 和 live/unknown fail-open；恢复严格一次。
dod: [BEHAVIOR] 失败轮 resumed=0，成功轮 resumed=1 且 replacement/provider/event 各一
[BEHAVIOR] real child kill+await 后 ESRCH 判 dead；kill 前 live PID 与 unknown host 不被判死

tasks.title: Gate 10：Draft exact-head evidence-only workflow
tasks.scope: 把 Worker-first candidate、CI、Evaluator、Judge 接入 P0 统一 workflow；三者只产 exact-head 证据，保持 Draft 且不 merge/deploy。
dod: [BEHAVIOR] ci→evaluator→judge 后 Draft=true、auto-merge off、merge/staging/production mutation=0
[BEHAVIOR] Worker admission 失败时 Brain candidate receipt=0

tasks.title: Gate 11：exact-head 人工授权与严格发布顺序
tasks.scope: 统一 Draft-before-evaluation、CI→Evaluator/Judge→exact-head owner approval→merge 门；Evaluator 只产证据，禁止其消费 owner approval 或执行 merge；仅 controller 可在授权后 Draft→Ready/merge。
dod: [BEHAVIOR] CI-only/non-owner/stale-head 均保持 Draft 且 merge count=0
[BEHAVIOR] evaluator 完成时 Draft=true、auto-merge off、staging/production mutation count=0

tasks.title: Gate 12：merge 后 staging、production canary 与 rollback drain
tasks.scope: controller 验证 authorized exact-head merge 后先真实 US staging recovery，再 production canary；禁止 main-push production、Fast Lane、schedule、skipped/idle staging 与 missing receipt 旁路；rollback 精确恢复旧构件并 drain Kernel 至 roll-forward。
dod: [BEHAVIOR] merge→staging E2E→production canary 严格有序且唯一 replacement/heartbeat/resumed/dispatch 成功
[BEHAVIOR] brain-ci-deploy/auto-staging-deploy/deploy 旁路 mutations 全部非零
[BEHAVIOR] rollback diff=0 且 Kernel dispatch 保持 drained
